data.name: TreeDescription
data.value: A tree of selectable items, written by hand or generated from data, with custom item content, levels loaded on demand and items moved with the pointer.

data.name: TreeSettingsDescription
data.value: The settings apply to the trees of the page.

data.name: TreeMultipleDescription
data.value: Off, selecting an item releases the previous one.

data.name: TreeStartExpandedDescription
data.value: Drives the Expanded parameter of its branches.

data.name: TreeDisableItemsDescription
data.value: Archives, certificates, Luxembourg and the cities marked closed can no longer be selected.

data.name: TreeLatencyDescription
data.value: Time taken by the branch loaded on opening.

data.name: TreeFailureDescription
data.value: The branch fails to load; closing and reopening it tries again.

data.name: TreeStaticHint
data.value: Each OmniTreeItem is placed in the markup; its children sit directly inside it.

data.name: TreeDataHint
data.value: Regions, countries and cities come from one list; the last branch is loaded when it is opened.

data.name: TreeCustomHint
data.value: TextContent puts an icon and a remark beside the name; Luxembourg is disabled but keeps its place in the traversal.

data.name: TreeMoveHint
data.value: These sample folders move in this preview only. Drag a document onto a folder; the grid follows the new structure.

data.name: TreeAccountsHint
data.value: Drag an account onto another to file it there: it becomes its child, and the branch it lands on opens.

data.name: SpreadsheetDescription
data.value: A basic spreadsheet: cells named by letters and numbers, formulas, keyboard navigation, a formula bar and a model bound both ways that serialises to JSON.

data.name: SpreadsheetSheetDescription
data.value: What the sheet shows and lets you change.

data.name: SpreadsheetReadOnlyDescription
data.value: Cells can still be selected and read, never changed.

data.name: SpreadsheetFormulaBarDescription
data.value: The active address and what was typed in the cell, editable there too.

data.name: SpreadsheetAddRowsDescription
data.value: A button above the sheet adds a row at the bottom.

data.name: SpreadsheetAddColumnsDescription
data.value: A button above the sheet adds a column on the right.

data.name: SpreadsheetColumnWidthDescription
data.value: Set by the page on its own class, through a variable of the package.

data.name: SpreadsheetDataDescription
data.value: The sheet is a serialisable model bound both ways.

data.name: SpreadsheetJsonDescription
data.value: Shows the model as it would be saved: inputs only, formulas included.

data.name: SpreadsheetMirrorDescription
data.value: A second sheet reads the same model, so an edit in the first shows there at once.

data.name: SpreadsheetHowTo
data.value: Arrows move, typing replaces the cell, Enter or F2 edits it, Enter commits, Escape cancels, Delete empties. Try =SUM(B2:D2), =AVERAGE(B2:B6), =B8/0 or =Z99.

data.name: CollectionsDescription
data.value: Movable cards on a board and searchable log lines.
